description:
RGB Combat

Mod requires LunaLib to use.

RGB Combat is about what most important in Starsector. Looking cool while smashing your fleet against the enemy. And so, I brought to you The Mod for maximum style.

We got:
- RGB projectiles
- RGB missiles
- RGB beams
- RGB shields
- RGB venting
- RGB overload
- RGB engines
- Disco Background

Spoiler

All that for ships and wings, and comes with extensive LunaLib settings:

Spoiler

Credits:
- Jaydee and Roflos for help with coding.
- Michael Hendricks for showing me RGB mods in Factorio, which originally inspired this mod

discordPostHtml:
RGB Combat? RGB Combat!!! Pretty rainbows or true gamer experience? It's for you to decide, I just done cool thing which I like myself.

Forum page: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35865

Download: https://github.com/Vexlia-Artemiss/RGB-combat/releases/latest/download/RGB.combat.zip
Requires Lunalib

So what it does? Pretty much adds RGB to everything I thought makes sense in combat.
Current list:

  • RGB projectiles
  • RGB missiles
  • RGB beams
  • RGB shields
  • RGB venting
  • RGB overload
  • RGB engines
  • Disco Background

With highly customisable LunaLib settings to tweak everything to your liking
aiDescription: Applies RGB color effects to various ship and wing components, including projectiles, missiles, beams, shields, venting, overload, and engines. Includes a disco background option and extensive settings configurable through LunaLib.
